title: Zodiac Z13 and Z32
caveat: These ciphers are so short that many different readings fit the same symbols. Progress means measuring that ambiguity honestly, not picking a favorite reading. Nothing here names or accuses anyone.

lay.tagline: Two short ciphers from the Zodiac letters that are still unread.
lay.summary: The Zodiac killer sent several ciphers to newspapers in 1969 and 1970. The long 340-symbol cipher was solved in 2020 and confirmed by the FBI. Two short ones, of 13 and 32 symbols, remain unread. They are too short to have a unique answer under simple substitution, so many readings fit. We have not run these yet; the plan is to measure how many readings fit rather than to pick one.
lay.what_it_is: Z13 is 13 symbols, sent with the claim that it contained the writer's name. Z32 is 32 symbols, sent with a map. With so few symbols, almost any short phrase with the right pattern of repeats can be made to fit.
lay.what_we_found: Nothing has been executed for these ciphers in this project. The solved Z340 is kept separate, as a control to reproduce, not a target.
lay.whats_next: First reproduce the published Z340 solution exactly, as a check of the tools. Then, for Z13 and Z32, count how many readings from a fixed word list fit each one, and publish several, not one.

faq.a: No unique reading is established. Many names and phrases fit 13 symbols, so a fit alone proves nothing.
Yes. Oranchak, Blake and Van Eycke solved Z340 in December 2020, and the FBI confirmed it.

researcher.summary: Status follows the Z340 solvers' account (Oranchak, Blake, Van Eycke, arXiv 2403.17350, sections 5.5 and 8.2): Z13 and Z32 unresolved, with many compatible readings under simple substitution. Planned: exact Z340 replay as a solved control, then bounded pattern-compatible enumeration (at most 10,000 checks, 20 stored witnesses) over a hashed lexicon.

statuses.closed-with-power: Closed with shown power: the search recovers planted texts of this kind, and the target scores like shuffled text.
statuses.tested-without-power: Tested, not closed: the search ran, but some hypotheses stay underdetermined, the budget ran out, or matched-length controls did not come back.
statuses.open: Open: not searched here, or not searched with a method shown to work.
